programs.title: Take My Tumor
programs.sub_title: The Woman Covered in Thousands of Tumors
programs.desc: Charmaine from Trinidad suffers from one of the most extreme cases of neurofibromatosis ever recorded; tumors cover every inch of her body and obstruct her ability to breathe and swallow; without surgery, these growing tumors threaten her life.

programs.title: Take My Tumor
programs.sub_title: The Woman With a Tumor Half Her Height
programs.desc: Thirty-year-old Alexandra has a 20-pound, sagging tumor that starts at the back of her neck and now reaches below her waist; as the tumor on Claudia's backside continues to grow, so does the urgency for surgeons to remove it.

programs.title: Take My Tumor
programs.sub_title: The Man With the Hanging Face Tumor
programs.desc: Despite his family's pleas, Marlow explores a high-risk surgery to remove a facial tumor; Amy has let the tumor on her back grow for more than 17 years; after finally making the decision to remove it, she learns that now it might be too late.

programs.title: Take My Tumor
programs.sub_title: The Woman With a Tumor for a Stomach
programs.desc: The bulbous tumor growing from Jennifer's stomach threatens her relationship with her long-time boyfriend; fifteen-year-old Marcelo travels from Angola to Los Angeles to have a massive neck tumor removed, but the operation may be too risky.
